Agent lab

Agentic, but still simple.

This page shows the workflow in plain language: intake, plan, execute, and verify. That keeps the AI feel without adding noise.

Step 01

Intake

Capture the task, constraint, and desired result.

Step 02

Plan

Break the work into a small sequence the agent can follow.

Step 03

Execute

Use Python services to run tasks, transform data, or generate outputs.

Step 04

Verify

Check the result before the next action or page update.
